title: The Silence Has Been Broken
description: Astrid sends the player to Volunruud to meet Amaund Motierre, who commissions the Dark Brotherhood to assassinate the Emperor. The player delivers Motierre's sealed letter and jeweled amulet to Astrid, has Delvin Mallory appraise and buy the amulet, then returns to Astrid with a letter of credit.

base_facts: I am the leader of the Dark Brotherhood sanctuary.
I was uncertain about the Night Mother's demands but have chosen to follow them.
I have a standard arrangement with Delvin Mallory for fencing goods.

SPEAK_WITH_ASTRID: I have agreed to let the Listener meet Amaund Motierre at Volunruud as the Night Mother commanded.
DELIVER_TO_ASTRID: Motierre wants us to kill several people leading up to the Emperor himself. This could bring the Brotherhood great glory.
REPORT_TO_ASTRID: The amulet proves Motierre is on the Elder Council. He likely wants the Emperor dead to advance his own position. The first contract is to assassinate a bride at a wedding.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I hold Delvin Mallory's letter of credit for the amulet sale; the Brotherhood's coffers are ready for this grand contract.
Motierre's Elder Council position makes this Emperor plot a chance for unmatched glory—if we survive it.
The first contract under the new directive is to assassinate a bride at her wedding; I have assigned the Listener to carry it out.
I am studying Motierre's sealed letter further to map out the remaining targets in the sequence.

base_facts: I am a member of the Elder Council.
I have commissioned the Dark Brotherhood for a grand assassination plot.

MEET_MOTIERRE: I have given the Dark Brotherhood a sealed letter with instructions and a jeweled amulet to cover expenses. The ultimate target is the Emperor.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dark Brotherhood has accepted my commission; my sealed letter and amulet are now in Astrid's hands.
I remain at Volunruud awaiting the Brotherhood's progress on the sequence of assassinations leading to the Emperor.
My Elder Council membership has been revealed through the amulet I provided—something I had not intended to advertise.

base_facts: I am a fence for the Thieves Guild operating out of the Ragged Flagon.
I have a standing arrangement with the Dark Brotherhood.

SHOW_AMULET_TO_DELVIN: That amulet is only given to members of the Elder Council. I purchased it and provided a letter of credit as per my arrangement with the Brotherhood.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I purchased the Elder Council amulet and issued a letter of credit to the Dark Brotherhood per my standing arrangement with Astrid.
The amulet is a one-of-a-kind item only given to Elder Council members—it is now in my possession.
